subject: ONE beaver in a tight tie, brown fur, two broad orange teeth, a flat tail, never held in one pose
second_characters: ONE stoat manager in a stiff collar a paw away, shoving sheets across the lens in EVERY beat; TWO clerks heaving crates at his shoulder

props.big: ONE dam as broad as the frame of office paper and gnawed desk legs, rising under his paws in EVERY beat; from 6.55 ONE dry crust as broad as his palm
props.small: A SWARM of sheets, staples and paper scraps tearing past the lens

environment: an office packed top and bottom with cubicles, crates and queueing clerks, no empty floor
lighting: hard midday daylight, bright and flat, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the beaver fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, his orange teeth never under a quarter of it. He works the paper dam and the camera orbits him on a hard arc, a new shot size every beat, chest-up to very close, never parking, the whole office wheeling around him. The manager, the clerks and loose sheets tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat. He throws his whole body into every beat, slamming, heaving, hurling, his tail cracking down on the dam. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.90, then the dam carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: MNO-gi-ye go-vo-RYAT, ne v den-GAKH SCHAS-tye, no po-KA ya ZDES, mne by na KHLEB, i na NO-vu-yu plo-TI-nu

timeline.line: Многие говорят: не в деньгах счастье.
timeline.a: chest-up, tie and paper dam both in frame, he slams both forepaws through the dam and heaves the stack up, the manager shoving sheets across the lens

timeline.line: Но пока я здесь, мне бы на хлеб.
timeline.a: he drags the whole stack right across the frame and hurls an armful past the lens, two clerks heaving crates the other way
he cracks his tail down on the dam, the stack bursts, and he swings both paws right across the frame, sheets tearing past the lens
he wrenches a desk leg out of the dam and drives it home with his shoulder, the office wheeling past the lens
the manager slaps ONE dry crust into his paws and the beaver whips it flat at the lens, then swings it across the whole dam
he hurls the crust up the dam crest and dives after it, shouldering the stack across the frame
the manager shoves another stack into his chest and he knocks it into the dam with his hip, sheets raking past the lens
the dam splits open under the crust and a wall of sheets hurls past the lens while he throws his body into the gap
he heaves the crust through the split and slams his whole body after it, the office wheeling past the lens

must_appear: 0.00 both forepaws slamming through the dam, the tie in frame; 4.20 his tail cracking down and the stack bursting; 6.55 ONE dry crust slapped into his paws and whipped flat at the lens; 7.25 the crust hurled up the dam crest; 8.65 the dam splitting and the beaver diving into the gap
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a camera riding beside him, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, a parked camera, a still or empty background, push in, wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, night, dark scene, a hero back to the camera, a hero held in one pose, a prop between his jaws, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.90, offscreen narration, English speech, a second beaver in frame, a second crust in frame, duplicate props
